replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA is a technique used to reduce the dimensionality of data. First, standardize the data. Then, compute the covariance matrix. Next, calculate the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the covariance matrix. Sort the eigenvalues in descending order and select the top k eigenvalues. The corresponding eigenvectors form the principal components. Project the data onto the new feature space. The mathematics can be complex, but there are many tools and software that can help you perform PCA without getting too deep into the math.
